name: web-cobalt-lime-web3-club-hero-with-scribbles
title: Cobalt and Lime Web3 Club Hero
whatItIs: A cobalt-blue landing hero with gigantic white caps '#CLUB SOCIALFI PEOPLE', lime hand-drawn arrows and squiggles, two frosted glass profile cards, a rotating circular sticker, and three white step cards below.
whatItMeans: Extra-large type with hand-drawn lime marks feels loud, youthful and crypto-native. Glass profile cards add polish.
techniques: Huge stacked uppercase heading that fills the width
Hand-drawn lime scribbles and arrows over the type
Circular text badge as a call-to-action sticker
Frosted avatar cards overlapping the heading
White rounded panel with three numbered steps

vocabulary.definition: Hand-drawn lines and arrows layered over a layout.
A round sticker with text set around its edge.
Cards or shapes placed partly over large type.
